sloka: तेनैव च मुहूर्त्तेन दिव्याभरणभूषिता: ।आगुर्विंशतिसाहस्रा ब्रह्मणा प्रहिता: स्त्रिय: ॥ २.९१.४२॥
transliteration: tenaiva ca muhūrttena divyābharaṇabhūṣitā: ।āgurviṁśatisāhasrā brahmaṇā prahitā: striya: ॥ 2.91.42॥

translations.english: On both the banks of those rivers, charming, celestial houses plastered with white clay appeared by the grace of Brahma.
